task.title: `workbook show <task>` does less relic work
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M62). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

`workbook show <task>` pays for relics in every repository, including one with no relics: a second listing of the task refs, a listing of the relic refs, and about three cache checks. The reference documents the cost.

## Wanted

Skip the second resolve when the caller already has the canonical task ID, and skip the relic work when the checkout holds no relics.

## Done when

- The Git process count of `workbook show <task>` in a repository with no relics equals the count before relics.
- The benchmark pins it.
